issue.title: Is it possible to use to mock some paths in sysfs?
issue.body:
I am developing a java library which it interacts with a Linux environment and I would like to know if it is possible to use mockito in testing phase.

The class which interacts with sysfs is:
https://github.com/jabrena/ev3dev-lang-java/blob/master/library/src/main/java/ev3dev/hardware/Sysfs.java

I would like to simulate values using mockito.

any idea?

final: {"number": 321, "label": "question", "route": "answer", "related": [2342], "evidence": ["mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/Mockito.java"], "reply": "Hi, Mockito cannot intercept reads from /sys or any other OS path. It mocks Java objects, not the operating system. The usual approach is to put the sysfs access behind an interface, for example a small class with a method like String readValue(String path). Your library code depends on that interface, and in tests you create a mock with Mockito.mock(YourInterface.class) and stub it with Mockito.when(...).thenReturn(...). Production code keeps a real implementation that reads the file. Mockito.mock and Mockito.when are documented in the Javadoc of the Mockito class in mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/Mockito.java. Hope this helps."}
